arabic text: DASTAAR SAY WOH MAAN KI RIDA TAK PAHUNCH GAYA
english translation text: Akbar's blood reached the King's cloak, and from the turban it reached the mother's chadar.

arabic text: AWAZ RANN SAY AAI KEH BABA MAIN GIR PARHA\nGIRTA HUA HUSSAIN SADAA TAK PAHUNCH GAYA
english translation text: A cry came from the battlefield: Baba, I have fallen.\nStumbling, Hussain reached the voice.

arabic text: AISAY GIRI HAI KHAIMAY MEIN AKBAR KI LASH PAR\nZAINAB KA KHOON KHAK E SHIFA TAK PAHUNCH GAYA
english translation text: Zainab fell upon Akbar's body within the tent\nso heavily that her blood reached the healing dust.

arabic text: LAILA YEH RO KY KEHTI THI AKBAR KAHAN HO TUM\nZAALIM KA HATH MERI RIDA TAK PAHUNCH GAYA
english translation text: Weeping, Layla cried: Akbar, where are you?\nThe tyrant's hand has reached my chadar.

arabic text: SEENAY MEIN NAIZA TORH KAY KEHTA THA YEH LAEEN\nDAIKHO HUSSAIN APNI QAZA TAK PAHUNCH GAYA
english translation text: Breaking the spear within his chest, the accursed one said:\nlook, Hussain has reached his death.

arabic text: MAULA ZAEEF HO GAYE KUCH DAIR MEIN MAGAR\nAKBAR KA LASHA AAL E ABAA TAK PAHUNCH GAYA
english translation text: The Maula aged within moments,\nyet Akbar's body finally reached the family of the cloak.

arabic text: JIS HATH NAY GIRAYA THA HUMSHAKAL E MUSTAFA\nNAIZA LIYE WOH HATH RIDA TAK PAHUNCH GAYA
english translation text: The hand that brought down Mustafa's likeness\nheld a spear and then reached for the chadar.
